channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula pede que TSE investigue suspensão de serviços de embaixadas dos EUA
item.description: Lula's campaign asked the TSE to investigate the suspension of U.S. consular services in Brazil as potential foreign interference in the elections. The move aims to prevent foreign influence in the electoral process.

item.title: Brasileirão: Cuca exalta melhora do elenco e comemora campanha no 2º turno
item.description: Cuca praised the tactical improvement of the Santos squad after their 2-1 victory in the San-São derby, celebrating the strong performance in the second half of the Brazilian Championship with 20 points earned. The coach highlighted new signings and collective performance, noting the team is tied for the lead with Flamengo. He also mentioned the possibility of Neymar playing in the upcoming match against Flamengo.

item.title: Conselho pede monitoramento da liberdade religiosa nas eleições
item.description: The CNDH requested the IACHR and the Special Rapporteur for Freedom of Expression to monitor potential risks to religious and expression freedoms during the 2026 elections, citing cases such as the fake news involving Flávio Bolsonaro and Our Lady of Aparecida. The goal is to track hostility against religious individuals and institutions, judicial decisions on content removal, and their impact on religious participation in public debate.

item.title: TSE usa critérios diferentes para julgar comerciais de Lula e Flávio
item.description: The TSE, through Minister Estela Aranha, applied different criteria when judging communications involving Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. In one case, Flávio requested the removal of Lula's statements about militia members, but the minister ruled that no specific criminal facts were described. In another case, the PL was sanctioned for misleading advertising linking Lula to former congressman Uldurico Junior, being ordered to remove the content under fine.

item.title: Quem são todos os candidatos a senador por Minas Gerais (MG) nas eleições de 2026
item.description: Seventeen politicians compete for two Senate seats in Minas Gerais in the 2026 elections, with candidates from various parties including Carlos Viana (PSD), Aécio Neves (PSDB), and Marília Campos (PT). The race is wide open with no runoff for senators.

item.title: Lula liga Flávio a Vorcaro e milícias em última propaganda
item.description: In his final campaign ad before the first round, Lula used a video narrated by Chico Pinheiro to attack Flávio Bolsonaro, highlighting his ties to Daniel Vorcaro, militia figure Adriano da Nóbrega, and the 'rachadinha' scandal. The ad also reused controversial quotes from Jair Bolsonaro, including comments about Venezuelan teenagers, reinforcing efforts to discredit the opponent.

item.title: Sem citar Lula, Anitta diz em vídeo que vota em quem é contra as bets
item.description: Anitta stated, without mentioning Lula, that she supports banning betting platforms and encourages voting for candidates against bets. She also advocated for ending the 6x1 work schedule and greater female participation in politics. Her statement follows the release of the provisional measure banning bets in Brazil.

item.title: A dois dias da eleição, Flávio ganha reforço de Nikolas durante 'bloquinho' em MG com dança, oração e ataques a Janja
item.description: Two days before the 2026 election, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) held a campaign rally in Montes Claros, MG, featuring dances, prayers, and attacks on the PT and First Lady Janja. The event, marked by chants and strong symbolism, underscored their alliance and forecast a first-round victory.

item.title: Em ato em MG antes do 1º turno, Flávio promete "virar triste página" do PT
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro pledged in Montes Claros to turn the page on the PT era and claimed Brazil will have a new president on Monday after the election. He emphasized dedication to his potential mandate and criticized PT management.

item.title: Defesa de deputados do PT acusa Flávio de tentar escolher relator no STF
item.description: The defense team of federal deputies Lindbergh Farias and Rogério Correia, from the PT party, rejected the accusation filed by Flávio Bolsonaro at the STF, claiming the senator is attempting to influence the appointment of the judge in the case, bypassing distribution rules. The lawyers requested the dismissal of the crime report and argued that parliamentary activity does not constitute a crime.

item.title: Campanha de Lula convoca “milhões de Lulas” para mobilização
item.description: The Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva campaign issued a statement signed by campaign manager Edinho Silva, urging party directors, committees, and brigades to intensify grassroots mobilization in the 48 hours before the first round of the 2026 elections, emphasizing door-to-door outreach, street leafleting, and walking tours. The appeal targets "millions of Lulas," reinforcing a strategy of popular engagement.

item.title: Democracia brasileira não vai aguentar muitas eleições realizadas dessa maneira, diz cientista político
item.description: Political scientist Leo Barreto warns that the increasing judicialization of electoral campaigns threatens the stability of Brazilian democracy. He criticizes delays in resolving legal disputes and strategies to direct cases to specific rapporteurs, which creates mistrust among voters and weakens the democratic process.

item.title: Empresas fazem protesto no MorumBis em 1° jogo após MP das bets
item.description: Following the publication of the provisional measure banning sports betting in Brazil, companies and clubs have reacted with protests and legal actions. In the first game after the MP, Morumbis displayed messages against the ban, while clubs requested a grace period from the Supreme Court. The measure impacts billions in football sponsorship revenues.

item.title: As pesquisas e o momento crítico da disputa entre Lula e Flávio na eleição presidencial
item.description: The final stretch of the presidential race between Lula and Flávio shows a tight contest with significant variations across major electoral colleges. Surveys indicate that some voters are still deciding their vote, which could influence the outcome. Political scientists emphasize the importance of undecided voters at this critical moment.

item.title: Veja como foi a sexta-feira (2) dos candidatos a presidente
item.description: On the eve of the first round of the 2026 elections, presidential candidates held walks, rallies, and events in various cities, emphasizing voter outreach and criticism of judicial interference. Lula encouraged senior voting and defended investments in education and science; Flávio Bolsonaro campaigned in Minas Gerais; Augusto Cury criticized judicial decisions and proposed a pact among powers. Other candidates held interviews, campaign closing events, and voter convergence events across different states.

item.title: Crusoé: Lula aposta em mini-documentário contra Flávio
item.description: Lula's campaign released a nearly seven-minute mini-documentary on social media accusing Flávio Bolsonaro of involvement in alleged crimes and scandals, two days before the election. The content compiles criticisms of the PL senator's political trajectory.

item.title: Datafolha em SP, MG, RJ, PE e DF: margem de Lula supera 2 milhões de votos
item.description: Datafolha released a presidential poll in five states (SP, MG, RJ, PE, and DF), showing Lula (PT) leading Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) by over 2 million votes (29.9M vs. 27.8M). While caveats like margin of error and abstention remain, the current trend favors the PT candidate.

item.title: MP da Bets: setor de apostas anuncia protestos durante jogos do Brasileirão
item.description: The federal government banned online betting through Provisional Measure 1.394/2026, signed by President Lula on September 25. In protest, ANJL and IBJR announced actions during Brazilian Championship games, claiming the ban strengthens the illegal market and exposes bettors to scams. The Ministry of Justice reported 88,000 illegal betting sites identified, but emphasized the need for regulation to curb organized crime growth.

item.title: Lula cobra Senado por fim da escala 6 X 1: “Brasil precisa fazer”
item.description: President Lula urged the Senate to advance the vote on the PEC ending the 6 X 1 work schedule, emphasizing the government's priority and praising Senate President Davi Alcolumbre's support. The proposal is expected to be discussed next week, though voting is unlikely due to procedural requirements and opposition. Lula stressed the need to improve Brazilian workers' conditions.

item.title: Quem são todos os candidatos a presidente da República do Brasil nas eleições 2026
item.description: Twelve candidates run for president in 2026, including Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. The race is marked by polarization and competing political legacies. The first round takes place on October 4th.

item.title: Fachin manda inquérito que apura existência de gabinete do ódio de Raquel Lyra ao STJ
item.description: The president of the Supreme Federal Court, Edson Fachin, forwarded an investigation to the Superior Court of Justice regarding an alleged ' hate cabinet' linked to the governor of Pernambuco, Raquel Lyra. The probe aims to verify the existence of a structured group for political defamation and disinformation.

item.title: Lula ou Flávio? Quem saiu mais prejudicado após cancelamento de debate da Globo
item.description: The cancellation of the Globo debate harmed President Lula more, according to political scientist Leo Barreto, as it particularly affects undecided voters in the final stretch of the campaign. Flávio Bolsonaro tried to frame the incident as censorship, but both candidates were negatively impacted. The debate was a key opportunity to reach undecided voters.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro em MG: "Poucas horas pra tirar o Brasil do cativeiro"
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) spoke in Montes Claros (MG), claiming only hours remain to 'free Brazil from captivity'. At a 'Blocão 22' event, he emphasized Minas Gerais' strategic weight as the second-largest electorate. A Datafolha poll released the same day showed Lula leading with 42% versus 36% for Bolsonaro in the state.

item.title: Renan Santos desafia Flávio a debate em troca de apoio no 1º turno
item.description: Renan Santos challenges Flávio Bolsonaro to a direct debate, offering first-round support if he loses. He criticizes the opponent's lack of proposals and focuses the proposal on ideas, without addressing scandals. The challenge occurs after the cancellation of a debate by Globo due to court decisions.

item.title: Pesquisas mostram a variação de Lula e Flávio nos três maiores colégios eleitorais do país nas últimas semanas
item.description: Recent Datapoll surveys in São Paulo, Minas Gerais, and Rio de Janeiro show diverging trends for Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). In São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro, Flávio leads numerically, but the gap between the two candidates is narrow and within the margin of error. In Minas Gerais, Lula maintains the lead.

item.title: Países alertam cidadãos sobre “riscos” nas eleições do Brasil
item.description: Countries including Canada, Germany, the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, and Australia issued travel warnings to their citizens regarding Brazil's 2026 elections, advising caution during political gatherings and crowded areas. The Federal Police carried out a preventive operation in São Paulo and the Federal District to investigate potential threats to diplomatic facilities, finding no confirmed risks.

item.title: Após Alcolumbre pautar fim da 6×1, Lula diz estar ‘convicto’ de aprovação da PEC
item.description: President Lula praised Davi Alcolumbre's decision to schedule the PEC ending the 6×1 work scale, reducing the weekly workday from 44 to 40 hours and ensuring two days of paid rest. The proposal, already approved by the Chamber, will be voted on in the Senate and requires 49 votes in both instances. Lula expressed confidence in its approval, emphasizing the advancement for Brazilian workers.

item.title: Quem são todos os candidatos ao Senado por Roraima (RR) nas eleições 2026
item.description: Thirteen politicians registered as candidates for the Senate in Roraima (RR) for the 2026 elections following the deadline set by the Electoral Justice. Among the candidates are Chico Rodrigues (PSB), seeking re-election, and Roberta Acioly (Republicanos), who is competing for one of the contested seats. Former governor Antonio Denarium was declared ineligible by the TSE due to abuse of power, and his successor, Edilson Damião, initially announced a Senate run but later withdrew to campaign for a seat in the Chamber of Deputies.

item.title: Renúncia de candidatura de Salles ao Senado é homologada pelo TRE
item.description: Ricardo Salles (Novo-SP) had his Senate candidacy resignation approved by TRE-SP, following pressure for right-wing convergence. The resignation occurred after the ballot closure, keeping his name on the ballot with votes considered null. The move aimed to avoid fragmentation and strengthen André do Prado's candidacy.

item.title: Pesquisa para presidente em SP no 1º turno: veja números recentes
item.description: A recent Datafolha poll for the 2026 presidential race in São Paulo shows a technical tie between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the first round. Both candidates are close in numbers in the state, keeping the race balanced.

item.title: TSE determina que votos em Garotinho sejam considerados nulos no Rio
item.description: The TSE ruled that votes cast for Anthony Garotinho (Republicanos) for Governor of Rio de Janeiro must be considered null and void. The decision was made by Minister Floriano de Azevedo Marques.

item.title: Preço do diesel dispara na reta final do 1º turno
item.description: The price of S10 diesel reached R$ 7.35 per liter in the final stretch before the 2026 first-round election, the highest since April, driven by global supply constraints and Brazil's dependence on imports, especially from the US. The surge directly impacts freight transport and the Brazilian economy, which imports between 25% and 30% of its diesel consumption.

item.title: Debate da Globo cancelado: como TSE e STF implodiram o último confronto
item.description: TV Globo canceled the final 2026 presidential debate 40 minutes before broadcast due to conflicting judicial rulings from TSE and STF regarding candidate participation. Minister Estela Aranha banned Lula's empty pulpit, while Justice Gilmar Mendes mandated Renan Santos (Mission) inclusion, prompting Flávio Bolsonaro's withdrawal.

item.title: Toffoli manda somar tempo de TV a governador do Ceará
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Dias Toffoli ordered radio and TV stations in Ceará to provide additional electoral advertising time to the coalition of Governor Elmano de Freitas (PT), who is running for re-election, even within the 48 hours prior to the election. The ruling aims to ensure equal conditions for electoral dissemination, in line with Supreme Court guidelines. The decision was published on Friday, November 2nd.

item.title: Ato com Lula em BH tem provocação a Nikolas Ferreira
item.description: During a Petrobras campaign rally in Belo Horizonte, First Lady Janja da Silva and activists publicly provoked federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG), using offensive language and banners referencing the lawmaker directly. Tensions between the two political groups escalated with retaliatory attacks during public demonstrations held on consecutive days.

item.title: Governo brasileiro reconhece violações na Nicarágua, mas nega ameaça
item.description: The OAS approved a resolution demanding the release of political prisoners in Nicaragua, which Brazil supported but opposed characterizing as a 'regional threat,' stressing such a designation belongs to the UN. Brazilian ambassador Ricardo Belli labeled the violations as serious but criticized pretexts for colonial interventions and the 'peace through force' logic.

item.title: Lula diz estar “convicto” de aprovação da PEC do fim da 6x1 no Senado
item.description: President Lula expressed confidence that the Senate will approve the PEC ending the 6×1 work schedule, following its inclusion on the plenary agenda. TheMeasure, a government priority, requires two Senate votes with at least 49 favorable votes each.

item.title: CNDH pede monitoramento à Comissão Interamericana e cita Flávio Bolsonaro e Nossa Senhora
item.description: The National Council of Human Rights (CNDH) requested the Inter-American Commission on Human Rights and the Special Rapporteur for Freedom of Expression to monitor potential risks to religious and expression freedoms during the 2026 elections. The initiative references controversial statements by officials linked to the Bolsonaro government, including Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and vice-presidential candidate Hamilton Mourão. The council emphasized the importance of ensuring everyone's right to freely express their beliefs without persecution or censorship during the electoral period.

item.title: Agência Brasil e veículos da EBC fazem cobertura especial das eleições
item.description: EBC conducts integrated, multiplatform special coverage of the 2026 elections, centered on the theme 'Public Journalism in Service of Democracy'. TV Brasil, Agência Brasil, and Rádio Nacional provide live coverage of voting and vote counting, integrated with RNCP partner stations. The coverage includes analyses, official TSE data, and updates on measures like Pix payments to poll workers and energy grid preparations.

item.title: Alcione pede voto para Lula entre eleitores com mais de 70 anos
item.description: Singer Alcione posted a video on social media urging voters over 70 years old to vote for Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) in the 2026 presidential election, emphasizing the decisive role of this demographic despite voting being optional. She highlighted that the election concerns issues such as education, minimum wage, and social policies under Lula's government, including Pé de Meia and Farmácia Popular. Alcione's appeal aligns with Lula's own calls for elderly citizens to participate in the vote.

item.title: Veja os números dos candidatos a governador em SP
item.description: Five candidates run for São Paulo governor in 2026. Izadora Dias (PCO) had candidacy denied by Electoral Court after party slate rejection; TSE upheld decision on September 30. Name may still appear, but votes will count as null.

item.title: Damares diz que Bolsonaro passou mal e que Michelle está “presa” com o ex-presidente
item.description: Senator Damares Alves (PL) claimed that former President Jair Bolsonaro (PL) fell ill at home on Friday, 2, during a campaign event in Brasília. She stated that Michelle Bolsonaro could not attend the event and is 'stuck' taking care of the former president. The statement was made in a video posted on the senator's Instagram account.

item.title: Espólio de Caiado, caso Master e agro: como serão as disputas ao governo no Centro-Oeste do Brasil
item.description: Center-West elections are influenced by the Banco Master scandal and BRB crisis, favoring candidates aligned with Flávio Bolsonaro. Celina Leão leads in the Federal District, while Mato Grosso and Mato Grosso do Sul show complex scenarios with potential wins for Bolsonaro allies.

item.title: Região Norte: saiba como serão as disputas a governador onde só um candidato é do PT
item.description: The 2026 elections in Brazil's Northern Region are expected to favor the right wing, with Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) strengthening his influence in states such as Acre, Pará, Rondônia, and Roraima. The PT, on the other hand, maintains only one gubernatorial candidacy in the region, with Expedito Netto in Tocantins, reflecting a significant strategic disadvantage for the party. The electoral competition is marked by the absence of direct support from Lula in several northern states.

item.title: Região Sul: como vai ser a votação para governador nos Estados onde o PL de Flávio domina as urnas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's PL leads gubernatorial polls in Brazil's Southern region, with strong chances in Paraná and Rio Grande do Sul, while PT has no own candidates there. This scenario benefits PL, potentially allowing first-round wins and reducing Lula's influence.

item.title: Haddad critica ausência de Tarcísio em debates e diz que campanha ‘mostrou vulnerabilidades’
item.description: Haddad criticizes Tarcísio's absence from debates and points to vulnerabilities in security, health, and education. According to Datafolha, Tarcísio leads with 50% of the votes, against 33% for Haddad. The campaign ends with an event in ABC Paulista, strengthening the PT base.

item.title: Cury avalia pedir adiamento do primeiro turno
item.description: Presidential candidate Augusto Cury (Avante) states that his team is considering filing a writ of mandate to request a one-week postponement of the first round, claiming that the cancellation of the Globo TV debate harmed his campaign.

item.title: 5 maiores doadores de 2026 destinaram R$ 22 milhões a candidatos
item.description: The five largest donors in the 2026 elections contributed R$22.42 million to candidates and parties, according to the TSE's DivulgaCand system. Rubens Ometto leads with R$6 million, followed by Carlos Suarez with R$5.74 million, highlighting the continued influence of individual donors after the 2015 ban on corporate contributions.

item.title: Governo brasileiro soube com antecedência de fechamento de embaixada e consulados dos EUA
item.description: The Brazilian government stated it was informed in advance of the US decision to suspend consular services in Brazil due to security concerns and is monitoring the situation. The suspension, announced on October 2, affects the embassy in Brasília and consulates in São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Recife, and Porto Alegre. The measure occurs before the first round of elections, but the government says the electoral process will not be affected.

item.title: Crusoé: O triste fim da candidatura de Renan Santos
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential candidate from the Missão party, saw his campaign collapse after being manipulated on the eve of the first round. His candidacy, initially linked to political renewal targeting youth and opposed to both Bolsonarism and Lulism, ended in a tragic and unusual manner.
